content.text: No exclusivity obligation on Client exists anywhere in the document; the licence grant expressly preserves Client's freedom to use alternatives.

input.quote: Notwithstanding the foregoing, Client is not obligated to utilize the License and is free to acquire, develop, license or otherwise utilize any other hardware, software system, design, formula, procedure or trade secret to provide software and services similar to the ones provided by TrueLink hereunder, so long as such
input.rationale: The Agreement imposes no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation on Client, so it sits at the preferred position. The licence in Section 2(a) is expressly non-exclusive and Section 2(a) affirmatively confirms Client "is not obligated to utilize the License and is free to acquire, develop, license or otherwise utilize any other hardware, software system, design, formula, procedure or trade secret" for similar software and services. Section 3(i)'s requirement to order credit reports from TrueLink bites only where Client voluntarily requests an underwriting approval "through a System using the Interface", so it is a sourcing condition on voluntary interface use rather than exclusive dealing, given the express freedom to use alternatives. The only competition-related restriction referenced (the Non-Competition Agreement in Section 8(d)) operates as a limitation on TrueLink's use of Credit Data and therefore benefits Client. No redline proposed.
